scenes.text: After a breakup, your digital life can stay tangled.
Untangle helps you find a starting point.
Meet Maya. She changed her password, but still has questions about the laptop and shared photos.
Her story becomes six checks, with preparation steps included. She chooses what to keep.
Before deciding, she explores what a password change affects, and what it leaves outside.
The checks become her plan. She can keep an unanswered question without marking it reviewed.
Save an encrypted file to pick up later, or review those questions with someone you trust.
Your pace. Your permission. Untangle. A little less tangled.
